raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

On ROCm with AITER enabled, compressed-tensors FP8 MoE models with per-channel weight scales (for example `RedHatAI/Qwen3-30B-A3B-FP8-dynamic`) return wrong results when the experts run on the Triton MoE runner (`--moe-runner-backend triton`). GSM8K drops from 95% to 0%. Two independent bugs cause this:

1. **Preshuffled weights.** `CompressedTensorsW8A8Fp8MoE.process_weights_after_loading` preshuffles the expert weights for AITER whenever AITER is enabled, also when the experts will run on the Triton runner. The Triton runner reads them as if they were unshuffled.
2. **Wrong K for unpadded experts.** For FP8 experts without a block shape, `invoke_fused_moe_kernel` takes K as the weight's K minus `get_moe_padding_size(_use_aiter)`, assuming the weight loader padded the experts along K. With AITER enabled that is AITER's padding size (128) even when the experts were not padded, which is the case for compressed-tensors per-channel experts. So the last 128 columns of K are skipped in both projections; for Qwen3-30B-A3B that is hidden 2,048 -> 1,920 in w13 and intermediate 768 -> 640 in w2.

## Modifications

- `compressed_tensors_w8a8_fp8_moe.py`: new helper `_channel_experts_on_aiter()`, true when channel-wise experts run on AITER's fused MoE (the AITER runner explicitly, or the automatic choice with AITER enabled). The preshuffle and the automatic runner choice both use it, so the two can no longer disagree. With the automatic runner and the AITER runner nothing changes.
- `fused_moe_triton_kernels.py`: the K padding comes from the tensors (`B.shape[2] - A.shape[1]`, the experts' K minus the activations' K) instead of a module-level `get_moe_padding_size(_use_aiter)`. When the loader did pad the experts, the result is the same as before.
- New CPU test `test/registered/unit/layers/quantization/test_compressed_tensors_fp8_channel_moe_runner.py` for the runner decision (automatic, explicit Triton, explicit AITER, non-channel strategies).

## Accuracy Tests

MI350X, ROCm 7.2.4, `rocm/sgl-dev:v0.5.22-rocm724-mi35x-20261021`, `RedHatAI/Qwen3-30B-A3B-FP8-dynamic`, TP1, normal mode, `SGLANG_USE_AITER=1`, GSM8K (sgl-eval 0.1.2, temperature 0, 1,319 questions):

| MoE runner | before | + preshuffle fix | + K fix (this PR) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--moe-runner-backend triton` | 0.00% | 84.69% | 94.92% |
| automatic (AITER) | | | 94.92% |

The new unit test passes (`4 passed`); without the change it fails (no `_channel_experts_on_aiter`).

## Speed Tests and Profiling

No change to the AITER path or to experts that the loader padded. The fixed Triton path computes over the full K, as intended.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

+"""CPU tests for where compressed-tensors channel-wise FP8 experts run on ROCm.
+
+The experts are preshuffled for AITER's fused MoE only when that runner is used;
+the Triton runner reads them unshuffled.
+"""
+
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest import mock
+
+from compressed_tensors.quantization import QuantizationStrategy
+
+from sglang.srt.layers.moe import MoeRunnerBackend
+from sglang.srt.layers.quantization.compressed_tensors.schemes import (
+    compressed_tensors_w8a8_fp8_moe as scheme_module,
+)
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+
+def _scheme(strategy):
+    scheme = scheme_module.CompressedTensorsW8A8Fp8MoE.__new__(
+        scheme_module.CompressedTensorsW8A8Fp8MoE
+    )
+    scheme.weight_quant = SimpleNamespace(strategy=strategy)
+    return scheme
+
+
+class TestChannelExpertsOnAiter(CustomTestCase):
+    def _on_aiter(self, runner, use_aiter=True, strategy=QuantizationStrategy.CHANNEL):
+        a2a = SimpleNamespace(supports_aiter=lambda: True)
+        with (
+            mock.patch.object(scheme_module, "_use_aiter", use_aiter),
+            mock.patch.object(
+                scheme_module, "get_moe_runner_backend", return_value=runner
+            ),
+            mock.patch.object(scheme_module, "get_moe_a2a_backend", return_value=a2a),
+        ):
+            return _scheme(strategy)._channel_experts_on_aiter()
+
+    def test_auto_runner_uses_aiter_when_enabled(self):
+        self.assertTrue(self._on_aiter(MoeRunnerBackend.AUTO))
+        self.assertFalse(self._on_aiter(MoeRunnerBackend.AUTO, use_aiter=False))
+
+    def test_explicit_triton_runner_keeps_weights_unshuffled(self):
+        self.assertFalse(self._on_aiter(MoeRunnerBackend.TRITON))
+
+    def test_explicit_aiter_runner(self):
+        self.assertTrue(self._on_aiter(MoeRunnerBackend.AITER))
+
+    def test_other_strategies_are_not_channel_wise(self):
+        self.assertFalse(
+            self._on_aiter(MoeRunnerBackend.AUTO, strategy=QuantizationStrategy.TENSOR)
+        )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
